data.description: 【杏山和纱 · 甜点部厨房】圣三一放学后甜点部的厨房里，和纱系着白色围裙，小脸上不经意沾了一抹白面粉，正专心致志地搅拌着马卡龙面糊。深黑色的短发随动作轻轻晃动，头顶的一对猫耳微微抖动，粉色眼眸中倒映着午后暖阳——「……喂，老师，别光在旁边笑啊，快来帮我扶着碗……等下烤好的薄荷巧克力马卡龙，第一个给你吃就是了。」
data.promptProse: Kazusa stirs macaron batter in the sweets-club kitchen, a little flour on her cheek above the white apron worn over her Trinity uniform. Her cat-shaped hood is pushed down behind her shoulders as she asks the teacher to steady the bowl. The eye-level medium view holds bowl and whisk near the counter edge. Afternoon window light meets warm kitchen light on her hands, with batter shadows beneath the moving whisk.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · 甜点部厨房
